label: No actual CONCRETE_6 individual, from reflexive dependence with the unrestricted bridge
meaning: Certifies the step result d86e618b left elementary: on the reflexive reading of DependsForBeing, the unrestricted dependence-to-grounding bridge makes every actual concretum ground itself; actual grounding as simple priority makes it simply prior to itself; priority requiring nonmutual dependence then requires that it both depend and not depend on itself. So these four OPEN premises exclude every actual concretum. Since STMT-PRIORITY-REQUIRES-NONMUTUAL-DEPENDENCE lies in every terminal God-existence package and the #1604 i-free route uses the other two bridges, that route is consistent only with a strict, non-reflexive reading of D at actual concreta unless it uses the distinct-relata bridge. The control ReflexiveCompatible shows the distinct-relata bundle has a model with reflexive D and actual concreta. A forced rejection of at least one of the four, not of a preferred one.
